description: The gravel hub: members, HTTP and API traffic, logins, backups, the servers it polls, its background jobs and the Go runtime (gravel docs/hub.md, Observability).

panels.description: No data is expected when no login provider is configured (auth).
panels.gravelOptional: no login provider is configured (auth)
panels.title: Linked identities

panels.description: 0 when the database did not answer the scrape's count queries in time.
panels.title: Counts readable

panels.description: No data is expected when no login provider is configured (auth).
panels.gravelOptional: no login provider is configured (auth)
panels.title: Linked identities over time

targets.expr: (sum by (handler) (rate(gravel_http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (handler) (rate(gravel_http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0) / sum by (handler) (rate(gravel_http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: Includes the pages' in-process calls (ADR-0005).
panels.title: Calls by procedure

panels.description: No data is expected when no call has failed in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no call has failed in the range
panels.title: Errors by procedure and code

panels.description: The admin dashboard's /admin/metrics reading this store through the hub (gravel#204): ok, unavailable, refused, too_large, no_store. No data is expected when nobody has opened /admin/metrics in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: nobody has opened /admin/metrics in the range
panels.title: Dashboard queries by result

panels.description: No data is expected when nobody logged in or linked in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: nobody logged in or linked in the range
panels.title: Login, link and Linked Roles attempts

panels.description: No data is expected when no request was rate limited in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no request was rate limited in the range
panels.title: Refused by a rate limit

panels.description: One-time codes typed in a game server's chat (gravel#5): started, linked, proven (again), taken (another member's account; nothing moved), bad_code, limited. Many bad codes from one server is someone guessing. No data is expected when nobody proved an account in game during the range.
panels.gravelOptional: nobody proved an account in game during the range
panels.title: Proofs in game

panels.description: Local account logins and registrations (ADR-0026): ok, refused (an unknown username or a wrong password), locked (5 failures in a row lock an account for 15 minutes, doubling), invalid (a refused username or password at registration), rate_limited, error. Many refused from one hub is someone guessing. No data is expected when local accounts are off, or nobody used them in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: local accounts are off, or nobody used them in the range
panels.title: Username and password logins

panels.description: One-time links that set or reset a local account's password (gravel#187): issued (by staff or from the host), used, invalid (an unknown, used or expired link), refused (a password the rules turned down). Many invalid is someone guessing links. No data is expected when local accounts are off, or no link was issued or used in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: local accounts are off, or no link was issued or used in the range
panels.title: Password links

panels.description: The authorization endpoint (ADR-0015): issued (a code went back to the app), denied (the member pressed Cancel), rejected (an unknown app or redirect URI, or a request the app got an error for), error. No data is expected when no app signed a member in during the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no app signed a member in during the range
panels.title: Sign-ins to apps

panels.description: By grant type and result. replayed is an authorization code presented twice: its tokens were revoked; investigate the app. No data is expected when no token was asked for in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no token was asked for in the range
panels.title: Token endpoint

panels.description: Apps checking a token they were handed (RFC 7662); an app may cache an answer for up to 60 s. No data is expected when no app introspected a token in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no app introspected a token in the range
panels.title: Introspections

panels.description: Red after 26 hours: the nightly backup missed a night. No data is expected when backups are not configured (backup.status_file) or none has succeeded yet.
panels.gravelOptional: backups are not configured (backup.status_file) or none has succeeded yet
panels.title: Since the last base backup

panels.description: No data is expected when backups are not configured or have never run.
panels.gravelOptional: backups are not configured or have never run
panels.title: Since the last run

panels.description: No data is expected when backups are not configured or have never run.
panels.gravelOptional: backups are not configured or have never run
panels.title: Last run succeeded

panels.description: No data is expected when backups are not configured (backup.status_file is empty).
panels.gravelOptional: backups are not configured (backup.status_file is empty)
panels.title: Status file readable

panels.description: Red after 10 minutes: the archive trails the database by more than archive_timeout allows. No data is expected when WAL archiving is off or has archived nothing yet.
panels.gravelOptional: WAL archiving is off or has archived nothing yet
panels.title: Since the last WAL segment archived

panels.description: No data is expected when WAL archiving is off.
panels.gravelOptional: WAL archiving is off
panels.title: WAL segments archived

panels.description: No data is expected when no WAL upload has ever failed.
panels.gravelOptional: no WAL upload has ever failed
panels.title: Since the last WAL failure

panels.description: Servers by health (docs/hub.md, Fleet health): up, degraded (a missed poll, stale, slow, starting), down (not answering, a refused credential, a host that keeps failing), idle (parked as asked), unknown (just started). GetFleetSummary says which and why.
panels.title: Fleet health

panels.description: Open alarms by kind (docs/hub.md, Alarms): a server down for 2 minutes, a refused or missing credential, a host failing, a stale or failed backup, WAL archiving failing, an unclaimed hub. Each closes when its cause does.
panels.title: Alarms open

panels.description: Down after two failed polls in a row (ADR-0010); the hub's log says why. No data is expected when no server is registered (servers.yaml).
panels.gravelOptional: no server is registered (servers.yaml)
panels.title: Reachable

panels.description: No data is expected when no server is registered, or none has answered yet.
panels.gravelOptional: no server is registered, or none has answered yet
panels.title: Since the last good poll

panels.description: No data is expected when no server is registered, or none has answered yet.
panels.gravelOptional: no server is registered, or none has answered yet
panels.title: Players now

panels.description: The max line is the public slots (War Dogs: MaxPlayers less MaxReservedSlots). No data is expected when no server is registered, or none has answered yet.
panels.gravelOptional: no server is registered, or none has answered yet
panels.title: Players over time

panels.description: How long each server's poll takes, answered or not; over 2 s makes it degraded. No data is expected when no server is registered.
panels.gravelOptional: no server is registered
panels.title: Poll duration (p95)

panels.description: The build each server runs, as the watcher last read it (every minute, ADR-0010). No data is expected when no server is registered, or none has answered yet.
panels.gravelOptional: no server is registered, or none has answered yet
panels.title: Build

panels.description: A game update: the watcher read a new build and the capabilities again. Re-record the fixtures (games/wardogs/README.md). No data is expected when no server changed build in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no server changed build in the range
panels.title: Build changes

panels.description: Kicks, bans, messages and moves the hub sent, by outcome; each is a row in the audit log (ListAuditLog). No data is expected when no moderation call was made in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no moderation call was made in the range
panels.title: Moderation calls

panels.description: Leases starting, ready or ending now (#20, ADR-0023). No data is expected when the hub has no lease key.
panels.gravelOptional: the hub has no lease key
panels.title: Leases holding a server

panels.description: By pool and what happened: requested, released, failed, never_ready (failed before its server was ready). No data is expected when no lease in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no lease in the range
panels.title: Leases

panels.description: No data is expected when no lease got ready in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no lease got ready in the range
panels.title: Request to ready (p95)

panels.description: Events a server's match plugin (MatchZy) posted (ADR-0024), by result: recorded, ignored (one the hub keeps nothing of), error. No data is expected when no match plugin posted an event in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no match plugin posted an event in the range
panels.title: Match events

panels.description: Demos a server's match plugin uploaded to the hub's object store, by result. No data is expected when no demo was uploaded in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no demo was uploaded in the range
panels.title: Match demos

panels.description: loaded, or vanilla when the set didn't load (a game patch broke it, a bad pin) and the server ran without it (#176). No data is expected when no lease asked for a plugin set in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no lease asked for a plugin set in the range
panels.title: Plugin sets

panels.description: The state of each cloud-VM server's host (ADR-0003): running and parked are where it rests. No data is expected when no cloud-VM server is registered (servers.yaml locations and vm).
panels.gravelOptional: no cloud-VM server is registered (servers.yaml locations and vm)
panels.title: Host state

panels.description: Long in a transition (creating, booting, starting, resizing, parking) means a step is stuck; the hub's log says which. No data is expected when no cloud-VM server is registered.
panels.gravelOptional: no cloud-VM server is registered
panels.title: In this state for

panels.description: A step that keeps failing, by its error word; it is retried with a growing backoff. No data is expected when no host step is failing.
panels.gravelOptional: no host step is failing
panels.title: Failing steps

panels.description: No data is expected when no cloud-VM host is running.
panels.gravelOptional: no cloud-VM host is running
panels.title: Hourly price

panels.description: What the cloud bills for the instances (the volumes and reserved addresses bill too, all month). No data is expected when no cloud-VM host ran in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no cloud-VM host ran in the range
panels.title: Hours running

panels.description: No data is expected when no host operation in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no host operation in the range
panels.title: Host operations

panels.description: No data is expected when no host operation in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no host operation in the range
panels.title: Operation time, p95

panels.description: No data is expected when no cloud-VM server pushed its log in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no cloud-VM server pushed its log in the range
panels.title: Log batches to the roster

panels.description: No data is expected when no banned player connected in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no banned player connected in the range
panels.title: Bans enforced on connect

panels.description: The players the rung of its scaling ladder each host is on is sized for (#37). No data is expected when no running server has a scaling policy.
panels.gravelOptional: no running server has a scaling policy
panels.title: Rung (players)

panels.description: A scaling decision waiting for a map change, a match's end or an empty server; the host's events say why. No data is expected when no server has a scaling policy.
panels.gravelOptional: no server has a scaling policy
panels.title: Waiting for a boundary

panels.description: The players a host was told to expect until a time (#172): the policy sizes it for them, and it doesn't park itself for being empty meanwhile. No data is expected when no host expects anyone.
panels.gravelOptional: no host expects anyone
panels.title: Expected players

panels.description: No data is expected when no scaling decision in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no scaling decision in the range
panels.title: Scaling decisions

panels.description: Resizes by direction and result: ok, refused by the provider, or failed (started again at the old size). No data is expected when no host was resized in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no host was resized in the range
panels.title: Resizes

panels.description: Snapshots of a parked host's data volume the owner asked for (#166); a new server's volume can be made from one. No data is expected when no volume snapshot in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no volume snapshot in the range
panels.title: Volume snapshots

panels.description: The game's environment file on a host was not the one the hub pushed (an edit by hand, a crash mid-write), so the hub pushed it again; the host's events say when. No data is expected when no host's environment file drifted in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no host's environment file drifted in the range
panels.title: Environment file drift

panels.description: Matches the stats store started from the polls (ADR-0012): a rotation, every counter dropping, or the first player on an empty server. No data is expected when no match was played in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no match was played in the range
panels.title: Matches recorded

panels.description: One row per player on a server per good poll. No data is expected when nobody was on a server in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: nobody was on a server in the range
panels.title: Player rows written

panels.description: A player came on a server, or came back after more than two missed polls (ADR-0035). The sessions feed /admin/activity. No data is expected when nobody came on a server in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: nobody came on a server in the range
panels.title: Player sessions started

panels.description: The stats store could not write a poll (the database); the next poll records from the store, so only that poll's time on is lost. No data is expected when every poll was recorded in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: every poll was recorded in the range
panels.title: Polls not recorded

panels.description: Per-match player rows past stats.raw_retention_months, moved into monthly totals and deleted (ADR-0012 §6). Boards keep their numbers.
panels.title: Rows rolled up

panels.description: Match results past stats.raw_retention_months whose players were anonymised, each with a token of their own in the series (#216). The scoreboards stay; nobody is named.
panels.title: Match results retired

panels.description: Feed events past stats.raw_retention_months whose players were anonymised, each with a token of their own (ADR-0011). The events stay countable; nobody is named.
panels.title: Feed events anonymised

panels.description: The rollup job runs every 6 hours; much over that means it is failing (gravel_hub_jobs_total, result error). Prometheus stores the runner's job label as exported_job, since the scrape's own job label wins.
panels.title: Since the last rollup

panels.description: Participation events first-party apps sent (ADR-0014), by kind and outcome: recorded; duplicate (a key the app sent before, not stored again); invalid (the request was refused, nothing stored; kind is "invalid" when the kind itself was). No data is expected when no app recorded participation in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no app recorded participation in the range
panels.title: Participation events

panels.description: War Dogs' feed posts only when it has events: at a server's start and every few seconds in a fight, nothing for hours on an empty server. Ten minutes of nothing with ten or more players on is a silence gap (ADR-0011). No data is expected when no server has a feed (servers.yaml feed), or none has posted yet.
panels.gravelOptional: no server has a feed (servers.yaml feed), or none has posted yet
panels.title: Since the last batch

panels.description: stored: kept before the answer; unauthorized: no valid feed token (server unknown); rate_limited, too_large, bad_request: refused; error: not stored, so lost (the sources do not retry). No data is expected when nothing posted to the ingest route in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: nothing posted to the ingest route in the range
panels.title: Ingest requests by result

panels.description: The parse job reads the stored batches with their source's parser (ADR-0011): parsed, or failed (kept, and read again by a newer parser). No data is expected when no batch was parsed in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no batch was parsed in the range
panels.title: Batches parsed by result

panels.description: Events stored from the batches. unknown: a kind the parser does not know yet, kept in the batch for 30 days for a parser that does; invalid: an event it could not read. No data is expected when no event was parsed in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no event was parsed in the range
panels.title: Events by kind

panels.description: Events a server sent again (the same source key); stored once. No data is expected when no server sent an event twice in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no server sent an event twice in the range
panels.title: Duplicate events

panels.description: Data a feed lost, recorded as gap events (ADR-0011 §5). hub_down: the hub was away while players were on; silence: no batch for ten minutes while ten or more players were on. No data is expected when no feed lost anything in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no feed lost anything in the range
panels.title: Feed gaps by reason

panels.description: A failed run is retried with backoff and never stops the hub; server_poll failures are a server that did not answer.
panels.title: Job runs by result

panels.description: prune runs every 10 minutes, servers_reconcile and ingest_feeds every 30 seconds, ingest_parse every 10 seconds, ingest_gaps and hub_alive every minute, ingest_prune hourly, server_poll at each server's interval.
panels.title: Since each job last succeeded

panels.description: The events log (ADR-0028): every action, transition and grant, appended in its source's transaction; notifiers and the admin dashboard read it. backup.failed and host.failing are the ones to look at. No data is expected when nothing happened in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: nothing happened in the range
panels.title: Events appended by kind

panels.description: Each delivery is a batch of up to 20 events (ADR-0028 §5). An error is retried with backoff and never lost; failing for an hour opens notifier.failing. No data is expected when no notifiers, or nothing to send in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no notifiers, or nothing to send in the range
panels.title: Notifier deliveries by result

panels.description: How old the oldest event waiting for each notifier is; 0 when it has sent everything. It grows while a notifier fails. No data is expected when no notifiers.
panels.gravelOptional: no notifiers
panels.title: Notifier lag
